title: step-n-classifying-invariant
description: The post-shift-quotient classifying invariant of a step-n substitution settling - the aperiodic classifying invariant refined by the step parameter n, with the uncountable-rank invariant collapsed under settling-shift equivalence to rank exactly n.

step.description: the step depth n indexing the substitution rule that generated the settling - one substitution-letter per row/column of the substitution matrix

settling-shift-quotient.description: the invariant is cl-inv(v) / ~settling-shift, quotienting the aperiodic invariant by the corpus's natural MLD settling-shift equivalence

rank.description: the cohomological rank, equal to the step parameter: cl-inv^(n)(v) in Z^n (step-n cohomological rank theorem; Anderson-Putnam Cech^1 cong Z^n)

self-similar-cohomology.description: after settling-shift the distinct firing-ordinals collapse to exactly n substitution-equivalence classes, one per substitution-letter

substitution-matrix-action.description: the rank-n invariant carries an action by the step-n substitution matrix; same n yields the same rank but matrices distinct up to conjugacy give distinct invariants (necessary but not sufficient for MLD-equivalence)
